question: Which test was successfully conducted by ISRO in the development of the semicryogenic engine in March 2025?

options.text: Static fire test of the rocket booster
Cold test of the fuel system
Flight test of the complete launch vehicle
Hot test of the engine power head test article

solution:
The correct answer is __**Hot test of the engine power head test article**__.

• The **semicryogenic engine** is a crucial element in the development of advanced rocket propulsion technology by **ISRO (Indian Space Research Organisation)**.
 
• A **hot test** is an essential procedure where the engine is fired at full throttle under real conditions to evaluate its performance and reliability.
